biotools.summary: PanTax is a pangenome graph-based taxonomic profiler designed for strain-level metagenomic profiling, compatible with both short and long reads and capable of analyzing single or multiple species. It overcomes limitations of sequence-based approaches by depicting the full range of genetic variability, showing significantly improved precision and recall compared to existing methods.
